body:
Founder real-time: 'use fatbaby proxy broker instead' -> 'build the features you need into that' -> 'set up a single nginx proxy' -> 'and then use fatbaby proxy broker to manage proxies instead of always asking for a new feature'.

Root cause of the earlier stall: sudo-queue/31-jewel-nginx-basic-auth.sh's own diff-check compared the live nginx file against this repo's already-edited copy (which always differ -- that IS the deploy), so it refused to apply every time by construction, since the moment it was written. Founder ran it, correctly reported something was wrong with the script.

Real fix, not a patch: pivoted JEWEL's exposure off sudo-gated nginx auth_basic entirely, onto the existing fatbaby-broker (user systemd, no sudo to redeploy). Broker features added: Route.PathPrefix + real bcrypt HTTP Basic Auth (broker/middleware.go checkBasicAuth, PRRJECT_FATBABY commit 9d536de) for browser-facing services that can't send a bearer token, and a real WebSocket relay (broker/proxy.go handleUpgrade -- was a 501 stub) via hijack + raw bidirectional TCP copy, opt-in per route via SupportsUpgrade. New tests cover both (path-prefix longest-match, Basic Auth challenge/accept, and a real hijacked-connection byte-relay test).

gpt2-alpine-c/config/broker-routes.json gained the jewel-jupyter route (0e07d2a). OKEMILY's /jewel/ nginx location now just proxies to the broker (127.0.0.1:8679), no auth_basic/htpasswd -- the broker is the real gate now (22a79e1). JEWEL's own systemd unit gained --ServerApp.allow_origin='*' since the broker legitimately rewrites Host when relaying, which otherwise breaks Jupyter's own same-origin websocket check (6d2f655). sudo-queue script rewritten with the fixed diff-check and no htpasswd step (3723239).

Verified with a real jupyter_client-shaped HTTP+WebSocket round trip THROUGH the broker: kernel start (POST /api/kernels with XSRF), real execute_request over the relayed websocket, status:idle received, kernel torn down. Also verified no-auth (401), wrong password (401), and correct Basic Auth (200) at the broker layer directly.

Still needs: the one remaining sudo run (sudo-queue/31-jewel-nginx-basic-auth.sh) to make https://okemily.com/jewel/lab reachable externally -- broker+jupyter are live and correct on localhost, confirmed by a real protocol round trip, but not yet reachable from the internet.

⚓ ☃
title: Broker gains path-based routing + real Basic Auth + WebSocket proxying; JEWEL pivoted onto it
